properties.description: Requirement A, part 3, built 2026-10-16. Truth weighs each opposing CONTRADICTS by the objection's own computed truth: holds refutes, unknown contests (proof status `contested`), fails is answered. A circle of objections reads unknown on both sides. Decision.status gains `contested`. It settles intent like `deferred`; detect_defects counts a contradiction between two nodes it governs as held open (swept.suppressed_by_held_open), and its own truth reads unknown.
properties.name: An objection counts as far as it holds (it refutes, contests or is answered), and a Decision set to `contested` keeps a dispute open on purpose without counting as a defect or as debt
